A XX Energy attack.
Attach to your opponent's MP. While
attached, your opponent may discard a V card
from his or her hand at the start of each turn. If he or
she does not, banish the top card of your opponent's
Life Deck. Place this card on top of your Life Deck
when your opponent deals critical damage.
